data.gender_notes: Hemashree is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Sanskrit words ‘hema’ meaning gold and ‘shree’ meaning prosperity. Hemashree is the goddess of earth and symbolizes fertility, growth, and prosperity. The name Hemashree carries the meaning “Goddess of the Earth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hemashree usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of the earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine feminine energy of the Earth
data.etymology: Hemashree belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of the Earth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hemashree total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hemashree is of Hindu origin, and its meaning symbolizes the abundant essence of prosperity and wealth associated with the material world in Hindu culture. The use of gold as a representation of matrimonial wealth in Hindu weddings emphasizes the importance of this name, as it underscores not just the financial but the spiritual well-being of the couple.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Hemashree holds deeper spiritual significance in Hinduism, where it is connected to the goddess of earth and fertility, identified as Prithvi Devi or Goddess Shri Parvati. The name represents the abundant grace, generosity, and nurturing nature of the goddess. Hemashree embodies an ultimate desire for material and spiritual wealth alike, for harmony, productivity, and the continued growth of divinity within oneself and others. In essence, it symbolizes the interconnectedness and balance between the earthly and divine aspects of existence.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Hemashree: Radiating purity and divine love, symbolizing the resplendent goddess Lakshmi embodied in every woman's soul.
